info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Points-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Points Retrieval API allows businesses to fetch the loyalty points earned by customers within the loyalty program. It provides access to points data for various consumers, including customer service representatives and marketing teams, who utilize this information to enhance customer engagement and reward management. This endpoint is essential for understanding customer behavior and implementing targeted promotions based on loyalty metrics. Additionally, it supports analytics and reporting efforts, thus helping optimize customer loyalty strategies.

get.description: Fetch the current balance of loyalty points for a user. This endpoint allows you to check how many loyalty points are available, which can be used for rewards or discounts.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving loyalty points. This should include the necessary parameters to specify the desired loyalty program and any filters applicable to the points being queried.
